summary: Exact candidate 4b304308 independently fixes the Python version-selection and device-validation contract, and its pinned archive contains the stated SM8x source correction. The original SM89 native launch failure cannot be independently rebuilt or executed in the prepared ROCm-only environment, so full resolution remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: At base 358c163, both wrappers exposed ver; ver=2 reached the same sgl_kernel::fwd boundary; SM89 was accepted; CUDA 12.10 was incorrectly rejected by lexicographic comparison.
At exact candidate 4b304308, 16 tests passed for public signatures, dependency pin, numeric CUDA comparison, capability decisions, input-device routing, and rejection before the instrumented backend.
Checked the exact checked-out source for CUDA 12.2/12.3/12.10/13.0, SM80/SM89/SM90/SM91/SM100, both wrappers, backend non-entry on rejection, and TypeError for removed ver=2.
Archive hash exactly matched the candidate pin and source contained the SM8x shared-memory/local-KV changes and CUDA numerical regression.
Native rebuild prerequisite failed because the candidate package requires torch==2.13.0 while the mandated prepared interpreter has torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2.
Direct native configuration failed because nvcc/CUDA toolkit is unavailable.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned device is AMD Instinct MI350X with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2. No NVIDIA GPU or CUDA-native flash_ops is available; no SM89 numerical execution occurred.

remaining_counterexamples: Rebuild the pinned native dependency and reproduce the original SM89 fp16/bf16 head-dimension-256 split-attention case against an independent numerical reference.
Execute SM89 local split and shuffled paged-KV cases, including CUDA Graph replay after V changes.
Inspect the rebuilt flash_ops CUDA binary and demonstrate actual SM86-cubin execution on SM89.
remaining_limitations: ROCm-only host: AMD MI350X, no NVIDIA GPU, nvcc, or cuobjdump.
The mandated prepared Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 does not satisfy the kernel package's torch==2.13.0 build requirement.
The installed prepared sgl_kernel package has common_ops but no importable flash_ops, so it cannot validate the candidate native path.
